method.name: visual_retrieval_hint_runtime_candidate_discovery_route_design_v1
method.description: Plans a future runtime candidate-discovery route that may use visual retrieval hints to expand candidates while preserving strict text-evidence answer gates.
limitations: No runtime route is changed in this phase.
No operational search index is queried.
No visual retrieval hint becomes answer-visible evidence.
No graph DB, ontology, memory card, or clustering write is planned here.
